title: Video Block
summary: A video block component for embedding video content from uploads or external platforms like YouTube and Vimeo.
features: Support for uploaded videos and embedded content from YouTube and Vimeo
Configurable auto-play and custom thumbnail/poster image support
Modal video player with standard playback controls
Accessibility support with captions and video transcriptions
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Video Block component enables content editors to embed and manage video content within page layouts, supporting both self-hosted uploads and popular external platforms to create engaging multimedia experiences.

## Use Cases

- Embed product demonstration videos or brand storytelling content on landing pages
- Upload custom video files or embed from YouTube and Vimeo using simple URL input
- Configure auto-play behavior for hero sections or background video loops
- Set custom thumbnail images to control the video preview appearance
- Play videos in a focused modal player with standard controls (play, pause, seek, volume)
- Provide captions and transcriptions for accessibility compliance
- Deliver optimized video quality based on user device capabilities and network conditions

## Design Rationale

The component abstracts the complexity of different video sources behind a unified interface, allowing content editors to work with uploaded files or external embeds interchangeably. Modal playback ensures videos receive full user attention while maintaining page layout integrity.
